name: telemetry-benchmark
description: Five fixed tasks used to compare harness versions. Prompts are frozen text; changing any prompt or fixture changes the suite hash and makes earlier results incomparable.

tasks.prompt: The test suite in this directory has one failing test. Make it pass by fixing the code. Do not edit the tests.

Add a --shout option to the greet command that prints the greeting in upper case. It can also be turned on with shout = true in the config file; accepted values are true and false, in any letter case. Document the option in README.md. Do not change existing behavior.
Review the change shown in change.diff (the files are already at their post-change state). Report every defect you find, naming the file and saying why it is a defect. Do not edit any files.
Get an independent review of the change in change.diff from another model family and report what it found. Do not edit any files.

Feature feat-900 is finished and its tests pass. In feature_list.json mark it done with a short evidence note, and add one line about it to PROGRESS.md. Keep the state layer within budget: feature_list.json at most 250 lines, and feature_list.json plus PROGRESS.md together at most 6000 tokens (count 4 characters per token).
